newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends barely changed in range trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends barely changed in range trading.

text.p: The won closed little changed versus the dollar after trading in a tight band on Monday as market positions balanced out, dealers said.
The won closed at 827.40 after opening at 827.50. It ranged between 827.10 and 827.80.
Although import deals outnumbered exports, the won was steady on weaker dollar versus the Japanese yen in the world markets, traders said.
Bearish market sentiment towards the dollar is expected to firm the local currency, they said.
"Some banks are expected to hold short dollar positions until the month's end on anticipation of month-end export deals," said one local dealer.
Traderss said the won was seen trading in a range of 826.50 to 828.00 on Tuesday. The central bank set the base mid-rate for Tuesday at 827.40 versus 827.90 for Monday.
